description:
IBS International Business School Budapest was founded in 1991 as Hungary's "First Private Business University". Together with its international education partner "The University of Buckingham", it has become a truly international business school with its English and Hungarian undergraduate, graduate and doctoral programs offered to students from all over the world. With the realization of Brexit, all IBS undergraduate and graduate programs are accredited in both the EU and UK.

Programs offered by IBS International Business School Budapest,

To be admitted to a university only in Hungary, you must first take the pre-admission exam of the university in Hungary. However, this is not the case for IBS.

Popular departments of the young university; Information Technology Management, Finance & Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Arts Management, Tourism Management, Political Science and International Business.

Important Note: There is a registration fee of 900 € for the first year.
